subject: AsterBio - Hosted API pilot proposal (early commit discount request)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@asterbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AsterBio - Hosted API pilot proposal (early commit discount request)

Sam —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Per our conversation, attached is the draft SOW and the pricing workbook for the 12-month pilot you asked about. Summary of the commercial ask:

- Product: Hosted API (generation + embeddings) for clinical annotation pipeline
- Proposed term: 12 months (early commit)
- Expected monthly usage ramp: 250k tokens --> 1.2M tokens by month 3
- Requested discount: 35% off standard hosted-usage list pricing for committed volume

We believe this is a strategic early customer in diagnostics and would like to extend an early-commit concession. Ben, can you confirm the internal approval required to commit to 35%? If we can get signoff today we will move to a DocuSign SOW and target a July 31 start.

Next steps: please review the SOW and confirm the usage floor you can commit to; we'll lock in the 35% for the committed tier once internal approvals are complete.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_AsterBio_draft.pdf, pricing_workbook_AsterBio.xlsx

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AsterBio - Hosted API pilot proposal (early commit discount request)

Lauren —

Looping Marcus and Mina for exec/finance clearance. As a reminder to the thread: our pricing policy requires VP/CRO approval for any net concession >20% on Hosted API list pricing. 35% is outside deal desk delegated authority.

Why I think this is approvable:
- AsterBio is evaluating Redwood for multi-product rollout across R&D + clinical pipelines (potential to expand to Dedicated later)
- They are proposing a 12-month committed spend that models to ~$180k ARR based on the workbook Lauren attached
- High reference value in diagnostics (regional pilot, case study potential)

Ask for leadership: Marcus, can you review and approve a 35% early-commit concession with the attached guardrails? Proposed guardrails: 1) 12-month term with a minimum billed commit of $150k; 2) Standard SLA and data controls; 3) One-time onboarding credit (already baked into the workbook).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/AST-2028-0730
DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/abcd-asterbio-2028

Ben Carter
Deal Desk
ben.carter@redwood.com

---Original attachment list preserved---
Attachments: pricing_workbook_AsterBio.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AsterBio - Hosted API pilot proposal (early commit discount request)

Ben / Lauren —

APPROVED (subject to conditions below). I reviewed the workbook and spoke briefly with Mina; the commercial rationale holds. Approving a one-time 35% discount for a 12-month early-commit pilot on the following terms:

1) Approval applies only to the Hosted API usage line items in the attached workbook and caps at $180,000 billed value for the first 12 months (i.e., we will not extend the concession beyond the committed spend in the workbook).
2) Customer signs the SOW with standard Redwood terms (no additional liability carve-outs). Legal to confirm no non-standard redlines — Lauren, please loop Legal and do not finalize until they sign off.
3) Finance (Mina) to confirm billing schedule and credit hold thresholds.
4) Marketing/Customer Success to be offered a short case study quote and reference arrangement — priority for public reference if pilot milestones met.

Ben — please capture this approval in the deal desk record and update the HubSpot deal with the approval note. Lauren — once Legal/Finance confirm, move to DocuSign and notify me on completion.

Approved by: Marcus Lin, VP Revenue Ops
Decision timestamp: 2028-07-25T17:40:00-07:00

Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@asterbio.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@asterbio.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AsterBio - Hosted API pilot proposal (early commit discount request)

Lauren —

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. We accept the terms as described and will complete the usage floor confirmation by EOD Friday. Please proceed with Legal/Finance and send the DocuSign when ready. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Sam Jenkins
Head of Data Science
AsterBio
sam.jenkins@asterbio.com
